title.en: What Is Your Tiny Finish-Line Treat?
title.zh: 小事告一段落：你想怎样庆祝一下？

description.en: Choose a small way to mark an ordinary finish: a sensory moment, a playful token or a little unassigned time.
description.zh: 选一种小事完成后的标记：感官小片刻、趣味小记号，或一段不安排的时间。

introduction.en: Imagine finishing a small recreational task. Rest and enjoyment do not need to be earned; this game simply explores how you might mark this particular ending without buying anything.
introduction.zh: 想象完成一件小休闲事。休息与享受不必靠表现换取；本游戏只看你怎样不花钱地标记这次结束。

focus.en: Marking completion through a present sensation, a visible keepsake or freedom from the next instruction.
focus.zh: 完成一件小事后，你想享受一小段愉快、留一个小记号，还是先不安排下一分钟？

prompt.en: Your paper project is finished. You would like…

label.en: A few minutes with a favorite sound or view.
label.zh: 听喜欢的声音或看景片刻。

label.en: A tiny dated mark on the back of the project.
label.zh: 在作品背后留一个小日期记号。

label.en: A little time with no next project assigned.
label.zh: 一点不指定下个项目的时间。

prompt.en: The finish is too small for a big celebration. You…
prompt.zh: 这次完成很小，不用大庆祝，你会……

label.en: Draw one small symbol that means “done for now.”
label.zh: 画个小符号，表示“先到这里”。

label.en: Let the next few minutes remain undecided.
label.zh: 让接下来的几分钟不决定。

label.en: Notice one ordinary pleasant detail already nearby.
label.zh: 留意身边已有的一处舒服细节。

prompt.en: A friend asks how you will mark the end. You say…
prompt.zh: 朋友问怎样标记结束，你说……

label.en: I would like to choose what happens next later.
I want a brief enjoyable moment before moving on.
I want a little trace that this piece reached an ending.
label.zh: 想留这件事告段落的小痕迹。

prompt.en: Your original idea is unavailable. You can still…

label.en: Find another small sensation in the place I already am.
label.zh: 在所在处找另一点小感受。

label.en: Make a simpler mark with whatever is already available.
label.zh: 用已有东西留更简单记号。

label.en: Keep the pause without filling it with a substitute task.
label.zh: 保留暂停，不塞入替代任务。

label.en: Seeing the little symbol and remembering the finished piece.
label.zh: 看小符号，想起完成的作品。

label.en: Remembering that I noticed a pleasant minute today.
label.zh: 记得今天有认真感受愉快一分钟。

label.en: Having let an ending stay an ending for a while.
label.zh: 曾让一个结束暂时就是结束。

label.en: Nothing else needs to begin this minute.
label.zh: 这一分钟不必另起一事。

label.en: Here is a small trace of what I finished.
label.zh: 这里留一点完成的痕迹。

label.en: Let me enjoy this one ordinary moment.
label.zh: 让我享受这个普通片刻。

summary.en: Your chosen treat is a brief experience you can actually notice. The finish gives you an occasion to pay attention, rather than an obligation to make the moment impressive.
summary.zh: 你选的庆祝，是一小段自己能享受到的体验。完成一件事，就有机会停下来留意此刻，不需要努力把它弄得格外精彩。

example.en: After folding a paper model, you might look out of the window and listen to one song you already enjoy.
example.zh: 折完纸模型后，你可能看窗外，听一首本来就喜欢的歌。

strength.en: A sensory moment can mark an ending without creating another object to keep or another elaborate activity to organize afterward.
strength.zh: 一小段喜欢的声音或景色，就能为事情收尾。不必多留一件纪念物，也不用接着筹备另一场复杂活动。

tradeoff.en: A pleasant minute may not be memorable, and that is allowed. Trying too hard to make every pause special can turn the treat into work.
tradeoff.zh: 愉快的一分钟，不一定要令人难忘。每次暂停都努力追求特别，也可能让犒劳自己变成新任务。

experiment.en: After any ordinary stopping point, notice one sound, color or texture you like. Let the experience finish without rating how rewarding it was.
experiment.zh: 一件普通小事告一段落后，留意一个喜欢的声音、颜色或触感。体验过去就让它结束，不必评分它有多值得。

summary.en: Your treat leaves a modest visible trace. A small mark gives this particular project an ending without turning it into a public performance or a permanent record of productivity.
summary.zh: 你愿意用一个看得见的小记号，为这件作品收尾。它不必拿来公开展示，也不需要成为长期记录自己效率的证据。

example.en: A tiny star drawn behind a homemade card might remind you when you decided the card was ready to give away.
example.zh: 在自制卡片的背面画一颗小星星，记住自己在什么时候觉得它已经可以送出。

strength.en: A chosen symbol can make a quiet finish tangible and preserve a detail that would otherwise disappear into the next ordinary activity.
strength.zh: 选一个小符号，就能把安静完成的这一刻留下来，不至于一转身就被下一件日常小事带走。

tradeoff.en: Keeping every token can become another collection to manage. You can let a mark be temporary or remove it without undoing what you finished.
tradeoff.zh: 每个记号都要保存，也会多出一份需要整理的收藏。它可以只留一阵，之后去掉，也不影响你已经完成的事。

experiment.en: Invent one small sign for a finished recreational piece. Put it somewhere optional and decide later whether it is still enjoyable to keep.
experiment.zh: 给一件做完的休闲小作品想一个标记，放在想放的位置。过一阵再决定，你是否仍喜欢留着它。

summary.en: Your chosen ending includes a little freedom from the next instruction. The treat is not doing nothing correctly; it is allowing the next moment to remain open.
summary.zh: 你选的收尾，是先不接着安排下一件事。不是要求自己正确地“什么都不做”，只是允许下一刻暂时没有计划。

example.en: You might put a finished puzzle aside and wait before choosing whether to chat, stretch, browse something or simply stay where you are.
example.zh: 你可放下拼好的拼图，稍后再选聊天、伸展、随便看看或原处待着。

strength.en: An unassigned interval can give a small finish its own boundary instead of immediately making it the starting signal for another project.
strength.zh: 暂不安排的一小段时间，能让刚完成的事在这里告一段落，不必立刻成为下一项任务开始的信号。

tradeoff.en: Open time will not always feel satisfying, especially when you want a specific activity. Choosing that activity is still compatible with this portrait.
tradeoff.zh: 空着的时间不一定总令人满足，尤其当你正想做一件具体的事。选择去做它，也不违背这个故事里的安排。

experiment.en: Leave one short interval after a harmless task undecided. When you do choose the next thing, let it be a fresh choice rather than a reward requirement.
experiment.zh: 一件普通小事结束后，先留一小段不作安排的时间。之后选下一件事时，把它当作新的选择，不必当成享受奖励的必要条件。

description.en: Mark an ordinary finish with a pleasant minute, a little symbol or unassigned time. Six choices reveal three tiny treats without spending money or having to earn rest.
description.zh: 用愉快一分钟、小符号或不安排时间，标记普通完成。六次选择，读三种小庆祝，不需花钱，也不需先赚得休息。

question.en: Do I have to finish something before I am allowed a rest?
question.zh: 必须完成事情以后，才有资格休息吗？

answer.en: Rest and ordinary enjoyment do not need to be earned. This quiz only explores a chosen way to mark one small finish: notice a pleasant moment, keep a little trace or leave the next interval open.
answer.zh: 休息与普通享受不需赚取。本测试只探索自选标记一个小完成的方式：留意愉快片刻、留小痕迹，或让下一间隙开放。
